title: Storm Sorceress
description: A female elf with long flowing blue hair stands at the center of a powerful oceanic storm. She holds a glowing orb-topped staff in one hand while casting swirling blue magic with the other, surrounded by turbulent waves, lightning, dark clouds, and sinking ships.
prompt: A beautiful female elf sorceress with long flowing blue hair and pointed ears stands dramatically in the center of a violent oceanic storm, wearing ornate blue and gold fantasy armor with bare midriff, holding a golden staff topped with a glowing orb in one hand while casting swirling blue magical energy with the other, turbulent waves and whirlpools surround her, dark stormy clouds with lightning bolts above, several wooden sailing ships sinking in the chaotic sea, ethereal blue spirits and magical particles in the air, highly detailed fantasy digital painting
